visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a dark blue t-shirt, sits in an indoor setting with warm lighting. She holds a bright orange-yellow snack bag and smiles toward the camera. Behind her, white walls with arched recessed niches are visible. (2) A man wearing a black sleeveless shirt attempts to pull the same yellow bag open with intense effort, leaning his body forward over a wooden table where a green glass bottle and a smartphone are placed. (3) A woman with long dark hair and bangs, wearing a dark navy dress, takes her turn pulling at the bag. Her face shows physical strain and squinted eyes as another pair of hands reaches in to help pull. (4) The camera focuses on the woman in the navy dress as she sits on a woven chair, gripping the bag with both hands and focusing intensely on the back seam. (5) A man slams the snack bag onto the wooden table in an attempt to pop it open. The bag lands near a cup of instant noodles and a smartphone. (6) Another woman wearing a black t-shirt and grey shorts sits cross-legged, using her entire upper body strength to pull the bag, before tossing it onto the table in mock frustration. (7) The first woman in the blue t-shirt successfully pulls the bag open, laughing and showing the open package to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched female laughter and fast-paced speech dominate, accompanied by a consistent, bright rustling of plastic. The tone is high-arousal and cheerful. (2) A series of metallic-like plastic crinkles as voices overlap in a shared effort. A male voice grunts slightly with exertion, mixed with female giggling. (3) A sudden, loud percussive thud occurs as a bag hits a wooden surface, immediately followed by high-volume female screams and explosive laughter. (4) Continuous loud plastic rustling and overlapping chatter from multiple female voices, peaking in loudness as they narrate the difficulty of the task. (5) A final loud 'pop' sound of plastic tearing, followed by a chorus of relieved laughter and high-valence exclamations.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to entertain through a humorous group struggle. It documents the extreme difficulty of opening a specific brand of snack bag (YAVA), using a montage of failed attempts by different friends to build comedic tension before finally achieving success.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While a brand is visible, the context is one of frustration/difficulty rather than a positive promotion.
